name: ABF World Title
epitaph: One of the Angle Based Fed's seven championships; a post of 27 June 2002 says that all its titles are vacant at the start of the company. Its own news post of 8 July 2002 puts all of its vacant titles on the line at its first Raw, and a post of 16 July bills a one-on-one world title match against Hulk Hogan. The fed's own champions list names Hulk Hogan as World Champion.

name: ABF Continental Title
epitaph: One of the Angle Based Fed's seven championships. Its Continental Title was among the vacant titles put on the line at its first Raw on 8 July 2002 and was defended again at the Raw reported on 16 July. The fed's own champions list names Randy Savage as Continental Champion.

name: ABF Euro Title
epitaph: One of the Angle Based Fed's seven championships. Its Euro Title was among the vacant titles put on the line at its first Raw on 8 July 2002; a post of 16 July reports a defense of it and a number-one contender named for it. The fed's own champions list names GoldDust as Euro Champion.

name: ABF Hardcore Title
epitaph: One of the Angle Based Fed's seven championships. Its card for the Raw of 29 July 2002 bills the Hardcore Title as a Hell in a Cell match, Mick Foley (c) against Rhyno, The Roaddogg and Spike Dudley. The fed's own champions list names Mick Foley as Hardcore Champion.

name: ABF Tag Team Titles
epitaph: One of the Angle Based Fed's seven championships. Its news posts carry a four-corners tag title match added to a Raw on 3 July 2002 and a defense reported on 16 July; its card for the Raw of 29 July bills The Outsiders (c) defending against Raven's team. The fed's own champions list names The Outsiders as Tag Team Champions.

name: ABF Cruiserweight Title
epitaph: One of the Angle Based Fed's seven championships. Its post of 30 June 2002 adds a Cruiserweight Title, to be on the line at the first show; its card for the Raw of 29 July bills Rico (c) against La Parka. The fed's own champions list names Rico as Cruiserweight Champion.

name: ABF Women's Title
epitaph: One of the Angle Based Fed's seven championships. Its post of 30 June 2002 adds a Women's Title, to be on the line at the first show. The fed's own champions list names Stephanie McMahon as Women's Champion.
